इक्षु: इक्षु इक्षु (akin to इष्), m. Sugar cane, Man. 9, 39.  -- Comp. काष्ठ-, m. a kind of sugar cane, Suśr. 1, 186, 15.
इक्ष्वाकु: इक्ष्वाकु इक्ष्वाकु, m.  1. The name of the first king of Ayodhya, Rām. 1, 70, 20.  2. A descendant of that king, Rām. 1, 70, 11.
इख्: † इख् इख् and इङ्ख् इङ्ख्, i. 1, Par. To go.
इङ्ग्: इङ्ग् इङ्ग् (probably a denomin. derived from इङ्ग), i. 1, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., Bhag. 14, 23), To move, MBh. 3, 8756. इङ्गित, n. Gesture, Man. 7, 67.
इङ्ग: इङ्ग इङ्ग, i. e. इञ्ज् (cf. Bṛh. Ar. Up. 6, 4, 23, akin to एज् and विज्) + अ, adj., f. गा, Moveable, MBh. 3, 8756.  -- Comp. निस्-, adj. immoveable, MBh. 12, 1558.
इङ्गुद: इङ्गुद इङ्गुद,  I. m. and दी f. The name of a plant, Terminalia catappa.  II. n. Its nut.
इच्छा: इच्छा इच्छा, i. e. इच्छ्, base of the pres. of 2. इष्, + अ, f. Wish, desire, Vedāntas. in Chr. 203, 19; Bhag. 5, 28. Will, Daśak. in Chr. 191, 10. इच्छया आत्मनः, Voluntarily, Man. 11, 73.  -- Comp. अन्-, f. absence of intention; °छ्हया, involuntarily, Man. 11, 124.  -- Comp. महा-इच्छ, adj. 1. high-minded. 2. liberal. यथेच्छम्, i. e. यथा-इच्छ + म्, adv. according to one's wish, Daśak. in Chr. 189, 21. स्व-, f. wilfulness, following one's own in-clination, Pañc. 87, 11.
इच्छु: इच्छु इच्छ् + उ (see the last), adj. Wishing, Śiś. 9, 82.
इज्या: इज्या इज्या, i. e. यज् + या, f. Sacrifice, Man. 1, 89.  -- Comp. भूत-इज्य, adj. one who makes oblations to the Bhūtas, Bhag. 9, 25.
इट्: इट् इट्, i. 1, Par. To go.
इडा: इडा इडा (akin to ईड्), f.  1. Refresh-ment, ved. Chr. 288, 16 = Rigv. i. 48, 16 (written इऌअ).  2. Oblations to the deities, MBh. 2, 1304.  3. Speech, Hariv. 14036.  4. Earth, MBh. 3, 14750.  5. The wife of Budha, MBh. 1, 3141.
इतर: इतर इ-तर (from the pronominal base इ, see इदम्), adj., f. रा, n. रद् (ved. रम्, cf. Lat. iterum),  1. Other, Man. 1, 70; इतर-इतरैर् अथ वा इतरैः, By these or those, MBh. 2, 2503.  2. Contrary, e. g. विजयाय इतराय वा, To victory or defeat, MBh. 1, 4092.  -- Comp. इतर-इतर, adj., used generally only in the oblique cases of the sing., 1. mutual, with each another, Pañc. ii. d. 136. 2. several Man. 3, 35. -- When the latter part of a comp. word it signifies,  I. negation of the former part, e. g. द्विज-, m. one who is not a Brāhmaṇa, Ragh. 9, 76. नर-, m. 1. a superhuman being, Bhāg. P. 4, 6, 9. 2. an animal, 3, 13, 49.  II. the contrary, e. g. दक्-षिण-, adj. left, Kumāras. 4, 19. प-रुष-, adj. mild, Ragh. 5, 68. सभ्य-, adj. vulgar, Bhartṛ. 3, 57. सव्य-, adj. right, Ragh. 12, 90. सहज-, adj. not innate, accidental. सित-, adj. black.
इतरतस्: इतरतस् इतर + तस्, adv., Repeated; इतरतश् चेतरतः, Hither and thither, Rām. 2, 105, 13.
इतरथा: इतरथा इतर + था, adv. Else, Śiś. 9, 13.
इतरेतरतस्: इतरेतरतस् इतरेतरतस्, i. e. इतर -इतर + तस्, adv. One from the other. MBh. 1, 7403.
इतस्: इतस् इ + तस् (from the pronominal base इ, see इदम्),  I. = the abl. of इदम्, Daśak. in Chr. 182, 2 (from this person, i. e. from myself); Hiḍ. 1. 5, than this, i. e. than  I. II. adv.  1. From hence, from this place, Rām. 3, 54, 28; from this time, MBh. 3, 204; therefore, Rām. 5, 81, 45.  2. Hither, Rām. 5, 13, 9; Ragh. 2, 34, against myself.  3. इतस् -इतस्, Here -- there, Śāk. 29, 20; इतश् चेतश् च, Here and there, Pañc. 20, 25.
इति: इति इति (probably a case of an original इ + त्य, see इदम्), adv.  1. Thus, Man. 2, 237.  2. It is used in quoting words or thoughts of one's self or some other: Man. 2, 129, तां ब्रूयाद् भवतीति, He may address her thus (i. e. by the word), भवति; Chr. 4, 15, अवोचम्॥।भीष्मः शान्तन-वः कन्या करतीति, I spoke thus: ‘Bhīṣma the son of Śāntanu robs the girls,’ i. e.  I. rob, etc.; Nal. 16, 9, तर्-कयाम् आस भैमीति, he thought thus: ‘she is the daughter of Bhīma’; Nal. 20, 14, न हि जानामि भवेद् एवं न वेति, I do not know (thus): may it be so or not, i. e. I do not know if it be thus or not. Generally words express-ing ‘to say,’ or ‘to think,’ are wanting, e. g. Pañc. 68, 25, अकुतो पि भयम् इति, ‘There is no danger from any quarter’ thus (thinking); Nal. 14, 14, न त्वां विद्युर् जना इति, ‘People will not know thee’ thus (thinking). Sometimes is added कृत्वा or ह, e. g. MBh. 1, 1522, सखेति कृत्वा, Thinking you are my friend, Man. 9, 45.  3. It often follows a question without expressing a dis-tinct meaning, e. g. Hit. 53, 18.  4. It is used to denote the conclusion of a book or chapter, Rām. 1, end.  5. With preceding किम्, Why, Daśak. in Chr. 197, 22.
इतिकर्तव्यता: इतिकर्तव्यता इति-कर्तव्य + ता, इति-कार्यता इति-कार्य + ता, and इतिकृत्यता इति-कृत्य + ता (vb. कृ), f. Business, Sāv. 3, 7; MBh. 3, 10031; 1, 7929
इतिहास: इतिहास इतिहास, i. e. इति-ह-आस (the last part is the third sing. of the pf. of 1. अस्) m. Traditional account, a legend, Man. 3, 232.
इत्थम्: इत्थम् इत्थम्, i. e. इद् + थम्, adv. Thus, Daśak. in Chr. 197, 10.
इत्था: इत्था इत्था, i. e. इद् + था, adv. Thus, Chr. 295, 17 = Rigv, 1, 92, 17. -- Cf. Lat. ita.
इद्: इद् इ + द् (properly the acc. n. of the pronominal base इ = Lat. id, Goth. ita, O.H.G. iz), a ved. part. laying a stress upon the preceding word, Chr. 290, 8 = Rigv. i. 64, 8.
इदम्: इदम् इ + द्-अम्, pron. sbst. and adj. The bases of the declension are अ m. and n., आ f., इ n. ई f., इ-म m. and n. इ-मा f., अ-न m. and n. अ-ना f., and ए-न m. and n. ए-ना f. This, Man. 2, 163; Nal. 7, 17 (16). Combined with other pronouns it may be translated Here, e. g. with the first psn., Chr. 24, 44, अयं गच्छामि, Here I go; with तद्, Rām. 5, 13, 31; with यद्, Hiḍ. 3, 19; with किम्, Hit. 18, 11. -- Cf. Lat. is, ea, id; Goth. is ita.
इदानीम्: इदानीम् इदानीम्, i. e. इ + दा + न + ई + म् (इदा ved., and, properly then, cf. ἰδέ), adv.  1. Now, Ṛt. 6. 29.  2. Presently, Śāk. 94, 2. -- Cf. Lat. idoneus.
इध्म: इध्म इध्म, i. e. इन्ध् + म, m. Fuel, Rām. 3, 21, 5.
इन्द्: † इन्द् इन्द्, i. 1, Par. To have supreme power.
इन्दीवर: इन्दीवर इन्दीवर, n. and. m. The blue lotus, Nymphæa cærulea, Indr. 1, 8; Daśak. in Chr. 199, 4.
इन्दु: इन्दु इन्दु, m. The moon, Rām. 3, 50, 12.  -- Comp. अ-बाल-, m. the full moon, Ragh. 6, 53. वदन-, m. a moon-like face, Śiś. 9, 30.
इन्द्र: इन्द्र इन्द्र, m.  1. The name of a deity, originally the supreme go of the Hindus. Rām. 1, 1, 83.  2. First, a king, especially as latter part of comp. words, e. g. खग-, m. The king of the birds, Pañc. i. d. 356; गज-, m. A huge ele-phant, Nal. 12, 54 (40); जन-, m. A king (of the people), Rām. 2, 100, 14. तृण-, m. The palmyra tree, MBh. 13, 6861. देव-, m. Indra, Arj. 4, 5. नग-, m. The Himālaya, Ragh. 2, 28. नर-, m.  1. A king, Man. 9, 253.  2. A phy-sician, Daśak. in Chr. 187, 12. महा-, m.  1. Indra.  2. A range of mountains, the northern part of the Ghats. मृग-, m. A lion. यक्ष-, m. Kuvera, the god of wealth. राक्षस-, m. Rāvaṇa, the king of the Rākṣasas, or demons, Rām. 3, 55, 35. राजेन्द्र, i. e. राजन्-, m. An emperor, a powerful king, Chr. 41, 5. सुर-, m. Indra, Bhartṛ. 2, 11. स-, adj. With Indra, Rām. 3, 51, 6.
इन्द्रकोषक: इन्द्रकोषक इन्द्र-कोष + क, m. A projection of the roof of a house form-ing a kind of balcony, Rām. 5, 9, 17.
इन्द्राणी: इन्द्राणी इन्द्राणी, i. e. इन्द्र + ई, f. The wife of Indra, MBh. 1, 7351.
इन्द्रिय: इन्द्रिय इन्द्रिय, i. e. इन्द्र + इय, n.  1. Power, Chr. 291, 2 = Rigv. i. 83, 2.  2. Semen virile, Man. 4, 220.  3. An organ of sense, Man. 1, 15.  -- Comp. अन्तर्-, n, the internal sense, i. e. the faculty of thinking. Vedāntas. in Chr. 217, 19. कर्मेन्द्रिय, i. e. कर्मन्-, n. an organ of action, e. g. the hand, foot, etc., Man. 2, 91. जित-, adj. one who has subdued his senses, Rām. 3, 49, 53. निस्-, adj., f. या, 1. having lost the use of a limb, Man. 9, 201. 2. powerless, Man. 9. 18 (? see Sch.). बुद्धि- (or ज्ङान-), n. an organ of perception and intellect, as the mind, eye, ear, etc., Man. 2, 91. स-, adj. with the organs of sense, Man. 1, 55.
इन्ध्: इन्ध् इन्ध्, ii. 7, Ātm., pf. ईधे,  1. To kindle; pass. इध्य, MBh. 3, 10821; ptcple. pf. इद्ध, Man. 8, 215.  2. To shine. -- With the prep. सम् सम्, To kindle, MBh. 3, 10658. Cf. ἰθαρός, αἴθω, αἰθήρ; Lat. aestus; O.H.G. eit.
इन्धन: इन्धन इन्ध् + अन, n. Fuel, Man. 7, 118.  -- Comp. अग्नि-, n. kindling a sacrificial fire, Man. 2, 108. अप्-, adj. having water for fuel, Ragh. 13, 14.
इन्धनवत्: इन्धनवन्त् इन्धन + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Possessed of fuel, Rām. 5, 75, 6.
इन्धनवन्त्: इन्धनवन्त् इन्धन + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Possessed of fuel, Rām. 5, 75, 6.
इन्व्: इन्व् इन्व्, i. 1, Par. (properly इ, ii. 5 इ + नु, which form is in the Vedas the base of the pres.),  1. To per-vade.  2. To please.  3. To satisfy. In the Veda especially: to further. --Cf. ἀνύω for αἰνύω, cf. γάνυμαι under जु।
इभ: इभ इभ, m. An elephant, Rājat. 5, 315.  -- Comp. गन्ध-, m. a kind of elephant, Rājat. 1, 300. जल-गन्ध-, m. a kind of elephant, or a गन्धेभ (see the preceding) living in water, Rājat. 5, 107. दिगिभ, i. e. दिश्-, m. an elephant of a quarter or point of the compass, one of eight attached to the north, north-east, etc., supporting the globe, Bhāg. P. 5, 14, 39.
इभ्य: इभ्य इभ्य-, i. e. इभ + य, adj., f. या, Wealthy, Daśak. in Chr. 186, 19.  -- Cf. probably ἴϕιος, ἴϕθιμος.
इयत्ता: इयत्ता इयत्ता, i. e. इयन्त् + ता, f. Quantity, Ragh. 6, 77.
इयत्: इयन्त् इयन्त्, i. e. इ + वन्त्, cf. ved. ई-वन्त्, with य् for व्, adj., f. यती।  1. So much, Kathās. 4, 95.  2. So large, Kathās. 12, 8.
इयन्त्: इयन्त् इयन्त्, i. e. इ + वन्त्, cf. ved. ई-वन्त्, with य् for व्, adj., f. यती।  1. So much, Kathās. 4, 95.  2. So large, Kathās. 12, 8.
इरा: इरा इरा, f.  1. Water.  2. The name of an Apsaras, MBh. 2, 393.
इरिण: इरिण इरिण, i. e. इरा + इन् + अ, n. Barren soil, Man. 3, 142.
इल्: इल् इल्, i. 6, Par.  1. To sleep.  2. To go, Hariv. 620. †  3. To throw; in this signification also i. 10, Par.
इव: ऽइव -इव, i. e. curtailed इ + वत् (see इदम्), indecl.  1. Like, Man. 2, 79.  2. In some way, Daśak. in Chr. 195, 14.  3. Almost, Nal. 17, 12.  4. Scarcely, Chr. 36, 15.  5. With न, Not very, Nal. 25, 19.  6. With किम्, Indeed, Śāk. 97, 15.
इष्: 1. इष् इष्, i. 4, Par.  1. To throw, ved.  2. To go. -- With the prep. अनु अनु, To search, Daśak. in Chr. 192 10, (cf. 2. इष्). -- With प्र प्र, Caus.  1. To throw, Rām. 3, 35, 46.  2. To direct, Śāk. d. 35.  3. To send, Rām. 3, 64, 7.  4. To make known, Rām. 1, 71, 17; प्रेषित, Banished, Rām. 2, 68, 8; m. A messenger, Śāk. 29, 12. -- With अनुप्र अनु-प्र, Caus. To send after, Rām. 4, 37, 10. -- With संप्र सम्-प्र, To throw, Chr. 30, 7. Caus.  1. To send, MBh. 2, 1179.  2. To send away, Rām. 4, 56, 17. -- Cf. ἴημι.

2. इष् इष्, i. 6, Par. (base of the pres. impf. imprt. and potent. इच्छ, but cf. अनु-),  1. To wish, Sāv. 5, 100; Yājñ. 1, 130.  2. To cherish, Man. 2, 159.  3. To chose, Man. 8, 384.  4. To approve, Man. 8, 366. Pass., To be fixed or determined, Bhāṣāp. 12; Yājñ. 3, 18; Man. 8, 322. Comp. part. of the pres. अन्-इच्छन्त्,  1. Not desir-ing, Rām. 5, 24, 8.  2. Unwilling, Pañc. 55, 4. Ptcple. of the pf. pass., इष्ट, Desired, good. Nal. 1, 1. m. A lover, Śāk. d. 78.  -- Comp. अन्-इष्ट, 1. disagreeable, Rām. 3, 14, 23. 2. dis-approved. Man. 9, 319. 3. wicked, Hit. i. d. 5. n. evil occurrence, Kathās. 18, 86. यथा-इष्ट + म्, adv. 1. according to one's wish, Bhartṛ. 2, 81. 2. carelessly, Man. 2, 198. -- Ptcple. of the fut. pass. एष्टव्य (anomal.), Desirable, MBh. 3, 8075; n. wish, MBh. 14, 1600. -- With the prep. अनु अनु,  1. To search, Man. 6, 84; with इष as base of the present, etc., MBh. 3, 15753.  2. To try Man. 8. 190.  3. To ask, Man. 4, 33. Comp. ptcple. of the fut. pass., दुस्-, Difficult to be searched through, Rām. 4, 86, 6. --Caus.  1. To search, Pañc. 214, 19.  2. To expect, Pañc. 182, 24. -- With पर्यनु परि-अनु, To search, MBh. 1, 1668. -- With समनु सम्-अनु, To search through, Rām. 3, 66, 1. -- With अभि अभि, अभीष्ट,  1. Desired, Vedāntas. in Chr. 202, 4.  2. Agreeable, Pañc. 77, 24. -- With आ आ, एष्टव्य (anomal.), Desirable, MBh. 3, 8075; n. Wish, MBh. 14, 1600. -- With पर्या परि-आ, पर्येष्टव्य (see the last), To be searched, MBh. 9, 229. -- With प्रति प्रति,  1. To receive, Sāv. 3, 12.  2. To obey, Rām. 1, 34, 30. -- With संप्रति सम्-प्रति, To assent, Rām. 1, 52, 13. Cf. ἰότης, perhaps ἵμερος.
3. इष् इष्, ii. 9, इष्णा, Par.  1. † To repeat an act.  2. ved. To further, Chr. 297, 16 = Rigv. i. 112, 16.
4. इष् इष्, f. A desirable object, comfort, Chr. 288, 15 = Rigv. i. 48, 15.
इषीका: इषीका 1. इष् + ईका, f. Reed, MBh. 1, 4332.  -- Comp. शर-, f. an arrow, Rām. 2, 104, 43, Gorr.
इषु: इषु 1. इष् + उ, m. and f. An arrow.  -- Comp. कुसुम-, m. the god of love. पञ्चेषु, i. e. पञ्चन्-, m. the god of love. पुष्प-, m. the god of love Cf. ἰός.
इषुधि: इषुधि इषुधि, i. e. इषु-धा (see निधि), m. and f. A quiver.  -- Comp. महा-, a great quiver.
इष्टका: इष्टका इष्टका, f. A brick, Rājat. 5, 463.
इष्टतस्: इष्टतस् इष्ट + तस् (vb. 2. इष्), adv. According to one's wish, Rām. 1, 34, 35.
इष्टाकृत: इष्टाकृत इष्टाकृत, i. e. इष्ट-आ(?) -कृत, n. The name of a sacrifice, MBh. 3, 10513.
इष्टापूर्त: इष्टापूर्त इष्टापूर्त, i. e. इष्ट-आ-पूर्त (vb. यज् and पॄ), n. Sacrifices and pious works, Rām. 1, 23, 8.
इष्टि: इष्टि इष्टि, f.  I. 2. इष् + ति, Wish.  II. यज् + ति,  1. Sacrificing, Chr. 296, 1 = Rigv. i. 112, 1.  2. Sacrifice. Man. 4, 10.  -- Comp. जात- (vb. जन्), f. a sacrifice on the birth of a child, Vedāntas. in Chr. 202, 16.
इष्मिन्: इष्मिन् 1. इष् + मिन्, adj. Hastening, Chr. 293, 6 = Rigv. i. 87, 6.
इष्वास: इष्वास इष्वास, i. e. इषु- 2. अस् + अ, m.  1. An archer, Rām. 1, 1, 12.  2. A bow, Rām. 3, 49, 48.  -- Comp. महा-, m. an archer.
इह: इह इह, i. e. इ + ध, which appears still in the Vedas, cf. इदम्, adv.  1. In this case, Chr. 55.  2. Here, Man. 9, 8; in this world, Man. 3, 181.  3. Hither, Chr. 13, 13.
इहत्य: इहत्य इह + त्य, adj. Of this place, Kathās. 13, 10.
